categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of various integrated circuits (ICs) including computer chipset ICs, embedded control ICs for notebooks, high-speed multimedia interface ICs, system-on-chip (SoC) products, and customized application ICs. It also engages in international trade, software services, and product design. Key product lines include PC peripheral control ICs, USB-C related products, high-speed video interface ICs, and human-machine interface SoCs for home appliances and automotive applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in IC design, leveraging advanced CAD tools for circuit layout and simulation. It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to professional foundries and subcontractors, maintaining quality control and assurance. Technologies include integration of high-performance graphic engines and CPUs in SoCs, USB 3.0 and USB-C protocols, RISC-V cores, and low-power design techniques. The company also develops ASICs and supports mainstream CPU platforms such as Intel, AMD, and ARM.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global PC and notebook manufacturers, multimedia device producers, and customers in the home appliance, automotive, and industrial sectors. Its products are embedded in desktop and notebook computers, high-speed video conferencing equipment, gaming and streaming devices, and smart home and automotive display systems. The company maintains close cooperation with leading brand customers and ODM/OEM partners.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with offices in Hsinchu Science Park and Taipei, and has a subsidiary in Shenzhen, China. Its sales are predominantly domestic (over 76%), with significant exports to Asian markets (about 23%), and minor sales to Europe and the Americas. The company is positioned within the global semiconductor supply chain, serving international customers and collaborating with global CPU and SoC providers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as an IC design house. It designs integrated circuits and outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries and subcontractors. It does not operate manufacturing fabs but controls quality and product development, positioning itself as a fabless semiconductor company.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous development of key technologies, adoption of new manufacturing processes to reduce costs, and innovation in customized, high-value, and growth-oriented products. The company focuses on supporting AI PC platforms, expanding USB-C and high-speed interface ICs, and developing human-machine interface SoCs for emerging applications. It aims to strengthen cooperation with strategic customers and build an SoC development ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor ICs and related integrated solutions. The company also earns income from licensing technology and providing design services. It distributes dividends to shareholders and invests in R&D to sustain product competitiveness and market share.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading global market share exceeding 40% in desktop and notebook PC peripheral control ICs. It competes with other semiconductor firms in high-speed multimedia interface ICs and human-machine interface SoCs. The company leverages close partnerships with major CPU and SoC manufacturers and focuses on modular product strategies and rapid development cycles to maintain competitive advantages against large competitors and emerging local players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported fiscal year, the company achieved revenues of approximately NT$6.63 billion, representing a 5.67% growth over the previous year. Net income after tax was NT$1.626 billion, with a gross margin of 55.62%. The company maintains a stable financial position with total assets of about NT$8.8 billion and equity attributable to owners of NT$6.7 billion. R&D expenses accounted for over 16% of net revenue, reflecting strong investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, timely technical support, and alignment with mainstream CPU platform evolutions to meet customer demands. Its modular design approach allows flexible product customization and rapid development, enabling it to serve diverse applications from PCs to automotive and smart home markets. The integration of advanced technologies such as RISC-V cores and low-power designs, along with comprehensive system solutions, differentiates it in competitive markets.
